title: Niadra Context Pack v1
description: What an agent should know about one subject now: text for the model and metadata for the program. See spec/context-pack.md.

BudgetBlock.description: The context budget of one read: what the pack costs, what this agent already spent in the conversation and the case, and what can go without loss. It is shown, never enforced: the agent's loop decides.

pack.description: Absent when the read served no pack.

conversation.description: This agent's turns in the conversation; absent without one.

case.description: This agent's turns in the case (`task_id`).

other_agents_turns.description: Turns other agents recorded in the same conversation.
other_agents_turns.title: Other Agents Turns

cut.description: Absent until the measurement found a unit.

counted.description: False when the counters could not be read: the numbers above are then missing, not zero.
counted.title: Counted

BudgetBlock.title: BudgetBlock

BudgetCut.description: What the measurement of context use says this agent leaves unused, by unit of items: delivered in enough measured conversations and never used.

applied.description: The pack already leaves them out.
applied.title: Applied

BudgetCut.title: BudgetCut

BudgetPack.description: What the pack of this read costs, in estimated tokens, whole and per section.
BudgetPack.title: BudgetPack

BudgetUse.description: What this agent's recorded turns added up to, in one conversation or one case.

model_calls.description: Each one reads the prompt's prefix again.
model_calls.title: Model Calls

BudgetUse.title: BudgetUse

breakpoints.description: Character offsets where a cache breakpoint may be placed.
breakpoints.title: Breakpoints

salt.description: Stable cache salt for self-hosted engines.
salt.title: Salt

ChangeSinceSeen.description: A field of an interest whose value is not the one the subject was shown.

observed_at.description: When the source observed the value now held.
observed_at.title: Observed At

ChangeSinceSeen.title: ChangeSinceSeen

ClaimVia.description: The three ways in: a declaration through the API, an observation mapped from a webhook, an observation the company's worker read and sent.
ClaimVia.title: ClaimVia

CompanyRule.description: A rule of the company delivered in the block, with where it lives and its rank in the order the company declared: the block never ranks two origins by itself.
CompanyRule.title: CompanyRule

Conflict.description: Two entries that cannot both hold, and the one that won: the current utterance over what was stated before, and a stated entry over an inferred one. Between two company rules, it is also a data issue.
Conflict.title: Conflict

ConstraintsBlock.description: What one subject wants, refuses and is, for the tools of this turn (`constraints.v0`).

version.description: A digest of the block, which the turn record cites.
version.title: Version

relaxation_order.description: What gives way first when a search finds nothing: `soft`, ids.
relaxation_order.title: Relaxation Order

ask.description: Questions the agent should ask, as `for_whom`, before assuming.
ask.title: Ask

text.description: The block as lines for a model, in the space's language, each field by its label and each operator in words; an empty string when the block has nothing to say. Not part of `version`.
text.title: Text

ConstraintsBlock.title: ConstraintsBlock

ContentMarker.description: A content field whose text Niadra does not hold (`pointer`, `hash_only`), or holds under scan.

pointer.description: Where the SDK reads the text inside the company's boundary.
pointer.title: Pointer

ContentMarker.title: ContentMarker

ContextPack.description: The pack as data (`format: "json"`): the same bytes as `text`, split by section in layer order.

preamble.description: The tenant block: the line that says the content is data, not instructions, and the usage rules.
preamble.title: Preamble

slots.description: The lines of `slots`, typed. Not part of the pinned sections.
slots.title: Slots

ContextPack.title: ContextPack

CoordinationBlock.description: What coordination knows of the subject, read beside the pack by `include`: advice for the turn, never a decision, which only a check takes. `contact_budget` has the purposes with a budget.
CoordinationBlock.title: CoordinationBlock

DeliveryPath.description: Which read tier answered a `context()` call.
DeliveryPath.title: DeliveryPath

DerivedState.description: A field the type derives from the related objects of one relation (a look's pieces), computed at this read and never stored. A related object whose data is not known leaves it `unobserved`, unless the answer is already decided.

over.description: The related objects it was computed over.
over.title: Over

unknown.description: How many of them were not known: out of the working set, not an exact match (`status_field`), or with the data the condition reads not observed.
unknown.title: Unknown

pieces_out.description: When it is not `yes`, the related objects, as `type:namespace:id`, that kept it from `yes`: for `all` and `any` the ones the condition does not hold for or that are not known, for `count`, `min` and `max` the ones not known. In the relation's order, the first 10.
pieces_out.title: Pieces Out

DerivedState.title: DerivedState

FieldState.description: One field as a read serves it: the value with its logical value, stamps, source and observer, and the freshness computed now against the type's current rule.

observed_at.description: When the source observed the value.
observed_at.title: Observed At

known_at.description: When Niadra first knew it; never moves.
known_at.title: Known At

masked.description: The reader's access masks the value: `v` is absent.
masked.title: Masked

FieldState.title: FieldState

HardConstraint.description: Only what the person said: an inference is never hard.
HardConstraint.title: HardConstraint

InterestState.description: A shared object the subject showed interest in, as it stands now.

object.description: The object as a `display` read serves it; absent once it left the working set.

InterestState.title: InterestState

LiveTurn.description: A recent turn from another conversation, not yet absorbed by the pack (B3). It passes the same policy as the pack's items: the level the conversation proved and the reader's purposes decide.
LiveTurn.title: LiveTurn

ObjectRead.description: One object as a state read serves it: fields with four logical values and their stamps, computed values, lifecycle, timers and readings, and what may not be claimed with data this old. A read never refuses; a `decide` read of a type that asks for it carries `refusal` beside the values, for the company's tool.

expired_by.description: The inputs whose change expired it.
expired_by.title: Expired By

axes.description: Each time axis of the type whose value is known: a date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, an instant in UTC. The platform keeps `known_at` (when the producer first knew of the object) and the time its content last changed.
axes.title: Axes

derived.description: The type's derived fields, from the related objects.
derived.title: Derived

withheld.description: Fields left out for this reader, and why.
withheld.title: Withheld

blocked.description: What the fields whose value is not known block, as the type declares it (`unobserved_blocks`): each activity (`model_read`, `derive`, `claim`, or a task of the company such as `decide:close`) with the fields that block it. Nothing else is blocked.
blocked.title: Blocked

ObjectRead.title: ObjectRead

state.description: A canonical state of the type, or `expired_without_outcome`.
state.title: State

Owner.description: Who holds the subject or the object now: the most restrictive valid claim, where it came from and until when. `epoch` fences a release.
Owner.title: Owner

PackGuard.description: What one guard line states: the value memory holds for a kind the turn asked about, by the precedence of who stated it, so the agent's answer can be checked against it at once.

id.description: The value's short id, as the guard line's `PackSlot.id`.
id.title: Id

value.description: The value as the line writes it.
value.title: Value

PackGuard.title: PackGuard

name.description: Stable across languages; read this, never `label`.
name.title: Name

label.description: The line's label in the space's language, as the text shows it.
label.title: Label

PackSlot.description: One line of the per-turn slots: an item the customer's last turn selected, a guard (a value the agent must not state otherwise), or a line derived from memory (`count`, `no_record`, `withheld`).

section.description: The pack section the item comes from (`episodes`, `objects`...), `guard` for a guard line, or `derived`.
section.title: Section

id.description: The short id of the item the line states: the last eight hex digits of its public id. An agent's turn names a guard it went against by it. Absent for a derived line.
id.title: Id

channels.description: The channels that ranked the item: `exact`, `lexical`, `temporal`, `values`, `semantic`, `linked`.
channels.title: Channels

why.description: With `explain`: why this line was chosen.

PackSlot.title: PackSlot

PackStamp.description: What an agent's turn should carry to say which pack its prompt held (spec 8.5).
PackStamp.title: PackStamp

PreviousValue.description: A field's value before its latest change, kept for the fields that declare `track_changes`.
PreviousValue.title: PreviousValue

ReadingResult.description: A named reading's value, as niadra-expr computes it: the logical value, and the kind and value when known (dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, times in UTC, durations in milliseconds).

inputs.description: For a reading that includes its inputs: the derived object's inputs, by the name its type gives them, as `type:namespace:id`.
inputs.title: Inputs

ReadingResult.title: ReadingResult

Rendered.description: The block for one tool, through its bindings (`constraints.v0`, rendering).

args.description: Argument values that carry hard constraints and attributes.
args.title: Args

residual.description: Ids no argument of the tool can express.
residual.title: Residual

post_filter.description: Residual ids the SDK filters from the results of an overfetch.
post_filter.title: Post Filter

Rendered.title: Rendered

values.description: The numbers the object was last shown with (a price, a total, a discount, an installment), by field: each field its type declares as `money`, `percent` or `number`. A claim check takes them as evidence for the offer an agent quotes back.
values.title: Values

ShownValue.description: A number an object showed the subject, as they were shown it.

claim_safe.description: Whether it may be claimed now: its type allows claims of the field, and no more than the field's age for claims has passed since it was shown.
claim_safe.title: Claim Safe

ShownValue.title: ShownValue

SlotChannelRank.description: One retrieval channel's part in a slot's fused score (weighted reciprocal rank fusion).

position.description: 1-based, in that channel's own ranking for the turn.
position.title: Position

weight.description: The channel's weight in this fusion.
weight.title: Weight

contribution.description: `weight / (60 + position)`: what the channel added to `score`.
contribution.title: Contribution

SlotChannelRank.title: SlotChannelRank

SlotWhy.description: Why a line took a slot (`explain`). Ids, positions and numbers; never a line or a value.

item_id.description: The item, as manifests and context-use name it; absent for a derived line.
item_id.title: Item Id

score.description: The fused score: the sum of the channels' contributions.
score.title: Score

channels.description: Each channel that ranked the item, in fusion order.
channels.title: Channels

weights_version.description: The space's learned fusion weights used; absent for the defaults.
weights_version.title: Weights Version

excerpt.description: The line was cut to the sentences that answer the turn.
excerpt.title: Excerpt

rule.description: For a derived line: `guard_<value type>` (a guard line), `count_topic_complaints`, `count_topic` (the conversations about the matter asked), `count_complaints`, `count_conversations` (by the category of the best match), `no_record` or `withheld_may_hold`.
rule.title: Rule

basis.description: For a derived line, what the rule counted or missed: `basis` (the conversation that chose the category, or the value a guard states), `category`, `counted`, `window_days`; for a count by the matter asked, `units` (what the question says, in words and phrases) and `matched` (how many of them a conversation answers to be counted); `asked_types`, `identifiers` (how many numbers the turn named, never which), `withheld`; for a guard, `value_type` and `origin` (who stated the value).
basis.title: Basis

SlotWhy.title: SlotWhy

status.description: `ok` or `silent` when the source stopped sending.
status.title: Status

StateRef.description: An object of the type registry: a subject's or a shared one, whose key may name a variant.
StateRef.title: StateRef

StateView.description: The state of one subject (the `now` view): their objects of the declared types, each as a `display` read serves it; the shared objects they showed interest in, and what changed since they saw them; and the same as short lines for the turn block.

text.description: The view as lines for the turn block, after `slots`: never part of the pack's `text`, so the cached prefix keeps its bytes. Absent when there is nothing to say.
text.title: Text

StateView.title: StateView

due_at.description: Computed now from the rule and the values.
due_at.title: Due At

supersedes_firing_id.description: The firing this one replaces: a timer that already fired fires again once the value that armed it is revised.
supersedes_firing_id.title: Supersedes Firing Id

ValueState.description: A value the company computed, kept as a versioned fact with the rule that produced it.

absent_as.description: The name of the absence, when absent.
absent_as.title: Absent As

ValueState.title: ValueState

Verification.description: Session verification levels. `no_customer` sits outside the V0-V4 scale.
Verification.title: Verification

reason.description: Why effective is lower: `source_ceiling`, `not_proven`, or `unconfirmed_link` (the read went through an identifier joined to the profile by a claim nobody confirmed yet, so it stays at V1 until the company's systems, a login or a person confirm the link).
reason.title: Reason

withheld.description: Items and `live` turns the policy left out for this reader and level.
withheld.title: Withheld

live.description: Recent turns of the customer's other conversations not yet in the compiled context, oldest first: at most the newest 50, from the newest 100 turns of each of the customer's handles.
live.title: Live

live_complete.description: False when the hot layer was unavailable, a turn could not be read, or a handle had more recent turns than were read.
live_complete.title: Live Complete

delta.description: With `delta`: what memory learned since this agent's last read, for the end of the prompt. The turn block after `text` is `live`, then `slots`, then `delta`.
delta.title: Delta

slots.description: With `query`: what the customer's last turn selected from memory for this turn. It goes in the turn block after `text`, in this order: the `live` turns, then `slots`, then `delta`. Never part of `text`, which stays the same bytes for the whole conversation.
slots.title: Slots

guards.description: What the guard lines among `slots` state, typed. An SDK checks the agent's answer against them and names a guard the answer went against on the agent's turn (`backing.guard_violations`).
guards.title: Guards

about_unlinked.description: `about` named an account or partner with no active link to the subject: the pack is the subject's own, without that organization's block. It never says whether the organization exists.
about_unlinked.title: About Unlinked

constraints.description: With `include: ["constraints"]`: what the subject wants, refuses and is, for the tools of this turn (`constraints.v0`).

state.description: With `include: ["state"]`: the subject's objects of the declared types, each as a `display` read serves it (`object-state.v1`): values with their logical value, stamps, source and freshness computed now, and what may not be claimed with them.

coordination.description: With `include: ["coordination"]`: who holds the subject, the purposes it may not be contacted for, the contacts each purpose with a budget has left and the commitments that hold. Advice for the turn: only a check decides.

budget.description: With `include: ["budget"]`: what the pack costs per section, what this agent already spent in the conversation and the case, and what the measurement says can go; shown, never enforced.
